AcceptInquiredSystemEvent.description_en: Accepts and authorizes the execution of a system event operation. For a system event in the Inquiring state, this operation accepts the default action of the system event and authorizes the system to execute the default action
AcceptInquiredSystemEvent.description_zh: 调用AcceptInquiredSystemEvent接受并授权执行系统事件操作。对问询中（Inquiring）状态的系统事件，接受系统事件的默认操作，授权系统执行默认操作

AddTags.description_en: Adds or overwrites one or more tags on Elastic Compute Service (ECS) resources. You can add tags to instances, cloud disks, snapshots, images, security groups, and other resources for easier management
AddTags.description_zh: 添加或者覆盖一个或者多个标签到云服务器ECS的各项资源上。您可以添加标签到实例、磁盘、快照、镜像、安全组等，便于管理资源

AllocateDedicatedHosts.description_en: Creates one or more pay-as-you-go or subscription dedicated hosts. A dedicated host is a physical server exclusively used by a single tenant. You can create ECS instances on a dedicated host and view the attributes of the physical server
AllocateDedicatedHosts.description_zh: 调用AllocateDedicatedHosts创建一台或多台按量付费或者包年包月专有宿主机。专有宿主机是单租户独享的物理机资源，您可以在专有宿主机上自行创建ECS实例和获取物理服务器属性等信息

AllocatePublicIpAddress.description_en: Assigns a public IP address to an ECS instance. We recommend that you call the ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec operation to assign a public IP address
AllocatePublicIpAddress.description_zh: 为一台ECS实例分配一个公网IP地址。推荐您使用接口ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec分配公网IP

ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Applies an automatic snapshot policy to one or more cloud disks
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 为一块或者多块云盘应用自动快照策略

AssignIpv6Addresses.description_en: Assigns one or more IPv6 addresses to an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
AssignIpv6Addresses.description_zh: 为弹性网卡分配一个或多个IPv6地址

AssignPrivateIpAddresses.description_en: Allocates one or more secondary private IP addresses to an Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can specify idle private IP addresses within the vSwitch to which the ENI belongs, or specify the number of private endpoint addresses to automatically allocate private IP addresses
AssignPrivateIpAddresses.description_zh: 为一块弹性网卡分配一个或多个辅助私网IP地址。可以为网卡指定在所属交换机（vSwitch）的空闲私网IP地址，或者通过指定私网地址数量自动分配私网IP地址

AssociateHaVip.description_en: Associates a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip) with an ECS instance or an elastic network interface (ENI)

AttachClassicLinkVpc.description_en: Invokes AttachClassicLinkVpc to connect a classic network type instance to a virtual private cloud (VPC) so that the instance can communicate with cloud resources in the VPC through private network peering
AttachClassicLinkVpc.description_zh: 调用AttachClassicLinkVpc将一台经典网络类型实例连接到专有网络VPC中，使经典网络类型实例可以和VPC中的云资源私网互通

AttachDisk.description_en: Attaches a data disk or system disk to an ECS instance
AttachDisk.description_zh: 为一台ECS实例挂载一块按数据盘或系统盘

AttachInstanceRamRole.description_en: Attaches an instance RAM role to one or more ECS instances
AttachInstanceRamRole.description_zh: 本接口用于为一台或多台ECS实例授予RAM角色

AttachKeyPair.description_en: Attaches an SSH key pair to one or more Linux instances
AttachKeyPair.description_zh: 绑定一个SSH密钥对到一台或多台Linux实例

AttachNetworkInterface.description_en: Attaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a VPC-type ECS instance by calling the AttachNetworkInterface operation with parameters such as NetworkInterfaceId, InstanceId, and NetworkCardIndex
AttachNetworkInterface.description_zh: 调用AttachNetworkInterface接口，并可以指定NetworkInterfaceId、InstanceId、NetworkCardIndex等参数，附加一个弹性网卡（ENI）到一台专有网络VPC类型ECS实例上

AuthorizeSecurityGroup.description_en: Adds one or more inbound rules to a security group. You can use this operation to specify inbound access permissions for a security group, allowing or denying other devices from sending inbound traffic to instances in the security group, which enables fine-grained network access control
AuthorizeSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口是阿里云 ECS 中用于增加一条或多条安全组入方向规则的接口。通过该接口，用户可以指定安全组入方向的访问权限，允许或者拒绝其他设备发送入方向流量到安全组内的实例，从而实现对网络访问的精细控制

AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress.description_en: Adds one or more outbound rules to a security group. This operation allows you to specify outbound access permissions for a security group to allow or deny instances in the security group from sending outbound traffic to other devices, enabling fine-grained control over network access
AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress.description_zh: 本接口是阿里云 ECS 中用于增加一条或多条安全组出方向规则的接口。通过该接口，用户可以指定安全组出方向的访问权限，允许或拒绝安全组内的实例发送出方向流量到其他设备，从而实现对网络访问的精细控制

CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy for one or more cloud disks
CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 取消一块或者多块云盘的自动快照策略

CancelCopyImage.description_zh: 取消正在进行中的复制镜像（CopyImage）任务

CancelImagePipelineExecution.description_zh: 取消一个镜像构建任务

CancelPhysicalConnection.description_en: Cancels an application for an Express Connect circuit. You can cancel an Express Connect circuit only when it is in the `Initial` or `Approved` state

CancelSimulatedSystemEvents.description_en: Cancels one or more simulated system events that are in the Scheduled or Executing state. After a system event is canceled, the simulated event enters the Canceled state
CancelSimulatedSystemEvents.description_zh: 调用CancelSimulatedSystemEvents取消一件或多件处于Scheduled（计划中）或Executing（执行中）状态的模拟系统事件。取消系统事件后，模拟事件变为Canceled（已取消）状态

CancelTask.description_en: Cancels a running task. You can cancel running image import tasks (ImportImage) and image export tasks (ExportImage)
CancelTask.description_zh: 调用CancelTask取消一件正在运行的任务。目前，您能取消正在运行的导入镜像任务（ImportImage）和导出镜像任务（ExportImage）

CloneDisks.description_en: Disk cloning allows you to quickly create a new disk with the same data as the source disk in the same zone. The cloned disk supports custom capacity, type, and encryption attributes. After the cloned disk is attached to an instance, you can quickly replicate business data or scale out services
CloneDisks.description_zh: 通过云盘克隆可以快速在同一可用区复制出一块与源盘相同数据的新云盘。克隆出的新云盘支持自定义容量、类型和加密属性，挂载至实例后，可实现业务数据的快速复制或服务的横向扩展

ConvertNatPublicIpToEip.description_en: Converts the public IP address (PublicIP) of a VPC-type ECS instance to an Elastic IP Address (EIP)
ConvertNatPublicIpToEip.description_zh: 将一台专有网络VPC类型ECS实例的公网IP地址（PublicIP）转化为弹性公网IP（EIP）

CopyImage.description_en: Copies a custom image from one region to another. You can use this operation to deploy ECS instances across regions or replicate ECS instances across regions
CopyImage.description_zh: 复制一个地域下的自定义镜像到其他地域。复制镜像可以实现跨地域部署ECS实例、跨地域复制ECS实例等目的

CopySnapshot.description_en: Copies a standard snapshot or encrypted snapshot from one region to another
CopySnapshot.description_zh: 将一份标准快照或加密快照从一个地域复制到另一个地域

CreateActivation.description_en: Creates an activation code that is used to register non-Alibaba Cloud servers as Alibaba Cloud managed instances
CreateActivation.description_zh: 该接口用于创建一个激活码，该激活码用于将非阿里云服务器注册为阿里云托管实例

CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Creates an automatic snapshot policy in a specified region. You can specify the repeat cycle, retention period, and cross-region backup settings for automatic snapshots to back up data on system disks or data disks
CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 在指定地域下创建一条自动快照策略。可以指定自动快照的重复周期、保留时间以及跨地域备份等策略，为系统盘或数据盘创建快照备份数据

CreateCapacityReservation.description_en: Creates a capacity reservation by specifying the instance type, total quantity, effective mode, and zone
CreateCapacityReservation.description_zh: 指定需要预留的实例规格、总数量，生效方式和可用区等，创建容量预定服务

CreateCommand.description_en: Creates a Cloud Assistant command of the Shell, PowerShell, or Bat script type
CreateCommand.description_zh: 新建一条Shell、PowerShell或者Bat脚本类型的云助手命令

CreateDedicatedHostCluster.description_zh: 创建一个专有宿主机组

CreateDeploymentSet.description_en: Creates a deployment set in a specified region
CreateDeploymentSet.description_zh: 在指定的地域内创建一个部署集

CreateDiagnosticMetricSet.description_en: Creates a diagnostic metric set for resources. You can flexibly combine diagnostic metrics as needed
CreateDiagnosticMetricSet.description_zh: 调用CreateDiagnosticMetricSet创建资源诊断指标集合。您可以根据需要，灵活组合诊断指标

CreateDiagnosticReport.description_en: Creates a resource diagnostic report. Based on the diagnostic metric set ID that you specify, a diagnostic report is generated for multiple diagnostic metrics. You can call DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes with the returned diagnostic report ID to query the details of the resource diagnostic report
CreateDiagnosticReport.description_zh: 调用CreateDiagnosticReport创建资源诊断报告。根据您传入诊断指标集合ID，生成多个诊断指标的诊断报告。您可以根据返回的诊断报告ID，调用DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes查询资源诊断详情

CreateDisk.description_en: Creates a pay-as-you-go or subscription data disk
CreateDisk.description_zh: 创建一块按量付费或包年包月的数据盘

CreateElasticityAssurance.description_en: Creates an elasticity assurance service by specifying parameters such as the zone, instance type, purchase duration, and auto-renewal settings within the region of the elasticity assurance service
CreateElasticityAssurance.description_zh: 通过指定弹性保障服务所属地域下的可用区、实例规格、购买时长、是否自动续费等参数创建弹性保障服务

CreateHaVip.description_en: Creates a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip)

CreateImage.description_en: Creates a custom image. You can use the created custom image to create ECS instances (RunInstances) or replace the system disk of an instance (ReplaceSystemDisk)
CreateImage.description_zh: 创建一份自定义镜像。后续您可以使用创建的自定义镜像创建ECS实例（RunInstances），或者更换实例的系统盘（ReplaceSystemDisk）

CreateImageComponent.description_en: Creates an image component. Image components are used to store commonly used build template commands for image building
CreateImageComponent.description_zh: 创建一个镜像组件。镜像组件用于存储您在构建镜像时，常用的构建模板命令

CreateImagePipeline.description_en: Creates an image template. Image templates can be used to build images
CreateImagePipeline.description_zh: 创建一个镜像模板。镜像模板可用于构建镜像

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance with customizable parameters
CreateInstance.description_zh: 本接口是阿里云 ECS 中用于创建实例的接口，支持创建一台包年包月或按量付费的 ECS 实例。您可通过此接口，依据自身需求灵活配置各类参数，实现实例的个性化创建

CreateKeyPair.description_en: Calls CreateKeyPair to create an SSH key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the private key in unencrypted PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format. You must securely store the private key on your own
CreateKeyPair.description_zh: 调用CreateKeyPair创建一对SSH密钥对。系统会为您保管密钥的公钥部分，并返回未加密的PEM编码的PKCS#8格式私钥。您需要自行妥善保管私钥部分

CreateLaunchTemplate.description_en: Creates an ECS instance launch template. A launch template eliminates the need to configure a large number of parameters every time you create an instance
CreateLaunchTemplate.description_zh: 创建一个ECS实例启动模板，简称模板。实例启动模板能免除每次创建实例时都需要填入大量配置参数

CreateLaunchTemplateVersion.description_en: Creates a new version of a specified ECS launch template for subsequent creation of ECS instances, elastic scaling groups, or auto provisioning groups
CreateLaunchTemplateVersion.description_zh: 在指定的ECS实例启动模板下创建一个新版本用于后续创建ECS实例、弹性伸缩组或弹性供应组

CreateNetworkInterface.description_en: Creates an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) with support for specifying a primary private IP address
CreateNetworkInterface.description_zh: 创建一张弹性网卡（ENI），支持指定主私网IP地址

CreateNetworkInterfacePermission.description_en: Grants Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user
CreateNetworkInterfacePermission.description_zh: 调用CreateNetworkInterfacePermission为阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）或者个人用户授权弹性网卡权限

CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow.description_en: Creates an O&M window. When the TargetResource parameter of the O&M window is set to associate with ECS instances and a hardware risk is detected at the underlying layer that requires scheduled O&M to mitigate, the execution time of the scheduled O&M is determined based on the time range specified by the TimePeriod parameter. When the execution time of the O&M event is reached, the platform automatically performs the corresponding O&M operation based on the event type
CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow.description_zh: 创建运维窗口。当运维窗口TargetResource参数设置关联的ECS实例，底层发生硬件隐患，需要通过计划运维来规避的时候，计划运维的执行时间会根据运维窗口TimePeriod 参数设置的区间来设置。当到达运维事件的执行时间后，平台会自动根据运维事件的类型来执行响应的运维操作

CreatePortRangeList.description_en: Creates a port list that can be associated with resources such as security groups
CreatePortRangeList.description_zh: 创建端口列表，后续可关联资源（例如安全组）使用

CreateSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口用于创建一个安全组

CreateSimulatedSystemEvents.description_en: Schedules simulated system events for one or more ECS instances. Simulated system events serve as event drills and do not actually execute events or affect ECS instances
CreateSimulatedSystemEvents.description_zh: 为一台或多台ECS实例预约模拟系统事件。模拟系统事件相当于事件演习，不会真正执行事件，也不会对ECS实例产生影响

CreateSnapshot.description_en: Creates a snapshot for a disk
CreateSnapshot.description_zh: 为一块云盘创建一份快照

CreateSnapshotGroup.description_en: Creates a snapshot-consistent group for disks in a specified ECS instance. A snapshot-consistent group contains snapshots of one or more disks
CreateSnapshotGroup.description_zh: 为指定ECS实例中的云盘创建快照一致性组。快照一致性组包含一个或多个云盘对应的快照

CreateVsc.description_en: Creates a Virtual Storage Channel (VSC) for an ECS instance
CreateVsc.description_zh: 为ECS实例创建虚拟存储通道

DeleteActivation.description_zh: 调用DeleteActivation删除一个未被使用的激活码

DeleteAutoProvisioningGroup.description_en: Deletes an auto provisioning group by specifying the AutoProvisioningGroupId and TerminateInstances parameters
DeleteAutoProvisioningGroup.description_zh: 指定参数AutoProvisioningGroupId、TerminateInstances删除一个弹性供应组

DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Deletes an automatic snapshot policy. If the target automatic snapshot policy has been applied to cloud disks, the cloud disks no longer execute the policy after it is deleted
DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 删除一条自动快照策略。如果目标自动快照策略已经被应用到磁盘上，删除自动快照策略后，这些磁盘不再执行该策略

DeleteCommand.description_en: Deletes a Cloud Assistant command. You cannot delete a command that is being executed
DeleteCommand.description_zh: 调用DeleteCommand接口，并指定参数RegionId、CommandId删除一条云助手命令。它无法删除正在执行中的命令

DeleteDedicatedHostCluster.description_en: Deletes a dedicated host cluster. Before you perform this operation, migrate the dedicated hosts in the dedicated host cluster to another dedicated host cluster
DeleteDedicatedHostCluster.description_zh: 删除一个专有宿主机组，操作前请先将该专有宿主机组下的专有宿主机迁移至其他专有宿主机组

DeleteDiagnosticMetricSets.description_en: Deletes diagnostic metric sets for resources
DeleteDiagnosticMetricSets.description_zh: 调用DeleteDiagnosticMetricSets删除资源诊断指标集合

DeleteDiagnosticReports.description_zh: 调用DeleteDiagnosticReports删除资源诊断报告

DeleteDisk.description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go data disk. Disk types include basic disks, ultra disks, standard SSDs, and enterprise SSDs
DeleteDisk.description_zh: 释放一块按量付费数据盘。磁盘类型包括普通云盘、高效云盘、SSD云盘和ESSD云盘

DeleteImage.description_en: Deletes a custom image. You can specify the ImageId and Force parameters
DeleteImage.description_zh: 调用DeleteImage接口，并可以指定参数ImageId、Force删除一份自定义镜像

DeleteImageComponent.description_en: Deletes an image component by specifying the RegionId and ImageComponentId parameters
DeleteImageComponent.description_zh: 调用DeleteImageComponent接口，并指定参数RegionId、ImageComponentId，删除一个镜像组件

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes or releases a specified ECS instance
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 删除或者释放一台指定的ECS实例

DeleteInstances.description_en: Releases multiple pay-as-you-go instances or expired subscription instances in a batch. You can specify whether to release or convert associated disks to pay-as-you-go disks
DeleteInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于批量删除或者释放按量付费实例或者到期的包年包月实例，支持通过参数设置决定云盘是否释放或转换为按量付费保留

DeleteKeyPairs.description_en: Deletes one or more SSH key pairs
DeleteKeyPairs.description_zh: 调用DeleteKeyPairs删除一对或者多对SSH密钥对

DeleteLaunchTemplate.description_en: Deletes a launch template in a specified region by specifying the LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName parameter
DeleteLaunchTemplate.description_zh: 指定参数LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName删除目标地域下的一个实例启动模板

DeleteLaunchTemplateVersion.description_en: Deletes one or more versions of a specified launch template by specifying parameters such as LaunchTemplateId and DeleteVersion
DeleteLaunchTemplateVersion.description_zh: 指定LaunchTemplateId、DeleteVersion等参数，删除指定实例启动模板的一个或多个版本

DeleteNetworkInterface.description_en: Asynchronously deletes an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
DeleteNetworkInterface.description_zh: 异步删除一张弹性网卡（ENI）

DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission.description_en: Deletes the permission to operate an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission.description_zh: 删除操作弹性网卡的权限

DeletePortRangeList.description_en: Deletes a specified port list. All port list entries in the port list are also deleted
DeletePortRangeList.description_zh: 删除指定端口列表，同时端口列表下的端口列表条目都将被删除

DeletePrefixList.description_en: Deletes a specified prefix list and all entries in the prefix list
DeletePrefixList.description_zh: 调用DeletePrefixList删除指定的前缀列表，同时删除前缀列表中的所有条目

DeleteSecurityGroup.description_en: Deletes a security group and all security group rules within it
DeleteSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口用于删除一个安全组，并关联删除组内所有安全组规则

DeleteSnapshot.description_en: Deletes a specified snapshot. You can also call this operation to cancel a snapshot that is being created
DeleteSnapshot.description_zh: 删除一份指定的快照。如果需要取消正在创建的快照，也可以调用该接口删除快照，即取消创建快照任务

DeregisterManagedInstance.description_en: Calls DeregisterManagedInstance to unregister a managed instance. After the instance is unregistered, you can no longer use Cloud Assistant to send commands or files to the instance
DeregisterManagedInstance.description_zh: 调用DeregisterManagedInstance注销一个托管实例。注销后您将无法再使用云助手向实例发送命令或文件

DescribeAccountAttributes.description_en: Queries the resource quotas that you can create in an Alibaba Cloud region. The quotas include the maximum numbers of security groups, Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs), pay-as-you-go instance vCPUs, spot instance vCPUs, pay-as-you-go cloud disk capacity, dedicated hosts, network interface controllers (NICs), network types, and whether the account has completed real-name registration
DescribeAccountAttributes.description_zh: 查询您在一个阿里云地域下能创建的ECS资源配额。包括您能创建的安全组数量、弹性网卡数量、按量付费vCPU核数、抢占式实例vCPU核数、按量付费云盘总容量配额、专用宿主机数量、网络类型以及账号是否已完成实名认证

DescribeActivations.description_en: Queries the activation codes that you have created and the usage of the activation codes
DescribeActivations.description_zh: 调用DescribeActivations查询已创建的激活码以及激活码的使用情况

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory.description_en: Invokes DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory to query the scheduling node information of an auto provisioning group
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory.description_zh: 调用 DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory 查询弹性供应组的调度任务信息

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupInstances.description_en: Queries the instances in an auto-provisioning group
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupInstances.description_zh: 查询一个弹性供应组内的实例信息

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroups.description_en: Queries one or more auto-provisioning groups
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroups.description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性供应组

DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations.description_en: Queries the associate relationships of an automatic snapshot policy
DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations.description_zh: 查询自动快照策略的关联关系

DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.description_en: Queries the details of automatic snapshot policies that are created in a specified region
DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定地域下已创建的自动快照策略详细信息列表

DescribeAvailableResource.description_en: Queries the inventory status of resources in a specified zone. This operation is primarily used to check whether target resources (such as instance types and system disk types) are sufficiently stocked in a specific zone before you create instances (RunInstances) or modify instance specifications (ModifyInstanceSpec)
DescribeAvailableResource.description_zh: 查询指定可用区的资源库存状态。该接口主要用于在创建实例（RunInstances）或修改实例规格（ModifyInstanceSpec）前，确认目标资源（如实例规格、系统盘类型）在特定可用区是否库存充足

DescribeBandwidthLimitation.description_en: Queries the maximum public bandwidth that can be purchased, upgraded, or downgraded for different instance types
DescribeBandwidthLimitation.description_zh: 调用DescribeBandwidthLimitation查询不同实例规格可以购买、升级或降配的公网带宽上限

DescribeCapacityReservationInstances.description_en: Queries the list of instances that match a capacity reservation
DescribeCapacityReservationInstances.description_zh: 查询容量预定服务已匹配的实例列表

DescribeCapacityReservations.description_en: Queries the details of one or more capacity reservations, such as the status, effective and expiration time, private pool mode, and number of used instances
DescribeCapacityReservations.description_zh: 查询一个或多个容量预定服务的详细信息，例如服务的状态、服务的生效与失效时间、私有池的模式和已使用的实例的数量等

DescribeClassicLinkInstances.description_en: Queries one or more classic network type instances that are connected to a virtual private cloud (VPC)
DescribeClassicLinkInstances.description_zh: 查询一台或多台与专有网络VPC建立了连接的经典网络类型实例

DescribeCloudAssistantStatus.description_en: Queries whether Cloud Assistant Agent is installed on one or more instances. If Cloud Assistant is installed, the response also includes the total number of command executions, the number of ongoing executions, and the time of the most recent command execution
DescribeCloudAssistantStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeCloudAssistantStatus查询一台或者多台实例是否安装了云助手Agent。如果已安装了云助手，还将查询云助手命令执行的总数量、正在执行的数量以及最近一次命令执行的时间

DescribeCommands.description_en: Queries Cloud Assistant commands that you manually created or public commands provided by Alibaba Cloud
DescribeCommands.description_zh: 查询您手动创建的云助手命令或者阿里云提供的公共命令

DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew.description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of one or more subscription dedicated hosts
DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew.description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew查询一台或多台包年包月专有宿主机自动续费状态

DescribeDedicatedHostClusters.description_en: Queries the details of one or more dedicated host clusters
DescribeDedicatedHostClusters.description_zh: 查询一个或多个专有宿主机组的详细信息

DescribeDedicatedHostTypes.description_en: Invokes DescribeDedicatedHostTypes to query the detailed parameters of dedicated host types supported in a specified region, or queries the ECS instance families supported by dedicated hosts
DescribeDedicatedHostTypes.description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostTypes查询指定地域下支持的专有宿主机规格详细参数，或者查询专有宿主机支持的ECS实例规格族

DescribeDedicatedHosts.description_en: Queries the details of one or more dedicated hosts. You can retrieve information such as the physical performance metrics, machine codes, usage status, and lists of created ECS instances on dedicated hosts. You can filter results by specifying parameters such as dedicated host IDs, dedicated host cluster ID, hostname, and status to precisely query the details you need, providing strong support for efficient management and optimization of cloud computing compute resources
DescribeDedicatedHosts.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台或多台专有宿主机的详细信息。通过该接口，您可以获取包括专有宿主机的物理性能指标、机器码、使用状态以及已创建的ECS实例列表等信息。您能够根据具体需求，通过指定相关参数，如专有宿主机ID列表、专有宿主机集群ID、宿主机名称、状态等，精准地查询所需的专有宿主机详细信息，为高效管理和优化云计算资源提供有力支持

DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTy.description_en: Calls DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily to query the instance families that support each deployment set strategy by specifying the RegionId and Strategy parameters
DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTy.description_zh: 调用DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily，并指定RegionId、Strategy参数，查询支持各部署集策略的实例规格族

DescribeDeploymentSets.description_en: Queries the details of one or more deployment sets
DescribeDeploymentSets.description_zh: 查询一个或多个部署集的详细信息

DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets.description_en: Queries the list of resource diagnostic metric sets by calling DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets
DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets.description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets查询资源诊断集合列表

DescribeDiagnosticMetrics.description_en: Queries a list of diagnostic metrics
DescribeDiagnosticMetrics.description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnosticMetrics查询诊断指标列表

DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes.description_en: Queries the details of a resource diagnostic report

DescribeDiagnosticReports.description_en: Queries a list of resource diagnostic reports
DescribeDiagnosticReports.description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnosticReports查询资源诊断报告列表

DescribeDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_en: Queries the key used for account-level default encryption of block storage
DescribeDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_zh: 查询块存储账号级默认加密使用的密钥

DescribeDiskEncryptionByDefaultStatus.description_en: Queries the service status of account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region
DescribeDiskEncryptionByDefaultStatus.description_zh: 查询指定地域块存储账号级默认加密的服务状态

DescribeDiskMonitorData.description_en: Queries the usage information of a cloud disk within a specified time period, such as read IOPS, write IOPS, read bandwidth (B/s), write bandwidth (B/s), read latency (μs), and write latency (μs)
DescribeDiskMonitorData.description_zh: 查询一块云盘在指定时间内的使用信息，例如，云盘读IOPS、写IOPS、读带宽（B/s）、写带宽（B/s）、读时延（μs）以及写时延（μs）

DescribeDisks.description_en: Queries information about one or more created block storage devices, including disks, local disks, and elastic ephemeral disks
DescribeDisks.description_zh: 查询一块或多块已创建的块存储（包括云盘、本地盘以及弹性临时盘）信息

DescribeDisksFullStatus.description_en: Queries the full status information of one or more block storage devices
DescribeDisksFullStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeDisksFullStatus查询一块或多块块存储的全部状态信息

DescribeElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttr.description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurance services
DescribeElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttr.description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性保障服务的自动续费属性

DescribeElasticityAssuranceInstances.description_en: Queries the list of running instances that are matched to an elasticity assurance
DescribeElasticityAssuranceInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeElasticityAssuranceInstances查询弹性保障服务已匹配的运行状态的实例列表

DescribeElasticityAssurances.description_en: Queries the details of an elasticity assurance service, such as the status, matching mode, effective method, expiration time, and number of used instances
DescribeElasticityAssurances.description_zh: 查询弹性保障服务的详细信息。例如弹性保障服务的状态、匹配模式、生效方式、失效时间、已使用的实例的数量等

DescribeEniMonitorData.description_en: Queries the traffic information of a secondary ENI within a specified time period
DescribeEniMonitorData.description_zh: 调用DescribeEniMonitorData查询一块辅助网卡在指定时间段内使用的流量信息

DescribeForwardTableEntries.description_en: Queries DNAT entries in a DNAT table

DescribeHaVips.description_en: Queries the details of high-availability virtual IP addresses (HAVIPs)

DescribeHpcClusters.description_en: Queries available HPC clusters. The request parameters are used as filters. The filters are evaluated by using a logical AND. The parameters are independent of each other
DescribeHpcClusters.description_zh: 调用 DescribeHpcClusters 查询您可用的HPC集群。请求参数作为筛选器（Filter）使用，筛选关系为逻辑与关系，参数之间无依赖关系

DescribeImageComponents.description_en: Queries the details of one or more image components
DescribeImageComponents.description_zh: 查询一个或多个镜像组件的详细信息

DescribeImageFromFamily.description_en: Queries the latest available custom image in a specified image family
DescribeImageFromFamily.description_zh: 查询指定镜像族系内最新创建的可用自定义镜像

DescribeImagePipelineExecutions.description_en: Queries the details of an image build task
DescribeImagePipelineExecutions.description_zh: 调用DescribeImagePipelineExecutions查询一个镜像构建任务的详细信息

DescribeImagePipelines.description_en: Queries the details of one or more image templates
DescribeImagePipelines.description_zh: 查询一个或多个镜像模板的详细信息

DescribeImageSharePermission.description_en: Queries all users with whom a custom image has been shared. The results are displayed by page, with 10 entries per page by default
DescribeImageSharePermission.description_zh: 查询一份自定义镜像已经共享的所有用户。持返回结果支分页显示，每页的信息条目默认为10条

DescribeImageSupportInstanceTypes.description_en: Queries the instance types supported by a specified image
DescribeImageSupportInstanceTypes.description_zh: 查询指定镜像支持的实例规格

DescribeImages.description_en: Queries the list of image resources available to you by specifying parameters such as ImageId, image usage scenarios, and Filter conditions
DescribeImages.description_zh: 指定ImageId、镜像被使用场景、Filter过滤等参数，查询您可以使用的镜像资源列表

DescribeInstanceAttachmentAttributes.description_en: Queries the private pool information matched by instances, such as the matching mode and private pool ID
DescribeInstanceAttachmentAttributes.description_zh: 查询实例匹配的私有池信息，例如匹配模式、私有池ID等

DescribeInstanceAttribute.description_en: Queries the attribute information of a specified ECS instance
DescribeInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台指定ECS实例的属性信息

DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription ECS instances, including whether auto-renewal is enabled and the renewal period
DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台或多台包年包月ECS实例的自动续费属性，包括是否开启自动续费、续费周期等信息

DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents.description_en: Queries the system event information of a specified instance by calling the DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents operation. You can specify parameters such as InstanceId and EventType. By default, this operation queries historical system events in inactive states
DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents.description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents接口，并可以指定InstanceId、EventType等参数，查询指定实例系统事件信息，默认查询处于非活跃状态的历史系统事件

DescribeInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.description_en: Queries the maintenance attributes of an instance

DescribeInstanceModificationPrice.description_en: Queries the price of upgrading an unexpired subscription ECS instance to a target instance type and the price of adding subscription data disks
DescribeInstanceModificationPrice.description_zh: 查询未到期的包年包月ECS实例升配时目标实例规格的价格信息、新增包年包月数据盘的价格信息

DescribeInstanceMonitorData.description_en: Queries the monitoring information of an ECS instance. Queryable metrics include vCPU usage, burstable instance credits, inbound data traffic, outbound data traffic, and average bandwidth
DescribeInstanceMonitorData.description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceMonitorData查询一台ECS实例的监控信息。可查询的指标包括ECS实例的vCPU使用率、突发性能实例积分、接收的数据流量、发送的数据流量、平均带宽等

DescribeInstanceRamRole.description_en: Queries the instance RAM roles that are assigned to one or more ECS instances by instance ID, or queries the instances that are assigned a specific instance RAM role by role name
DescribeInstanceRamRole.description_zh: 本接口具备两个主要功能，支持依据实例 ID 来查询一台或多台 ECS 实例所被授予的实RAM角色，同时也允许通过实例 RAM 角色名称来查询被授予了该特定角色的实例情况

DescribeInstanceStatus.description_en: Queries the status information of one or more specified ECS instances and supports querying instance lists based on specified conditions
DescribeInstanceStatus.description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询一台或多台指定ECS实例的状态信息，同时支持查询指定条件下的实例列表

DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies.description_en: Queries the list of instance families provided by Alibaba Cloud ECS. This operation retrieves instance family information across different series to help you understand available instance type resources and select appropriate instance types for creating ECS instances
DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies.description_zh: 本接口用于查询阿里云 ECS提供的实例规格族列表。通过该接口获取不同系列的实例规格族信息，从而更好地帮助您了解可用的实例规格资源，为您选择合适的实例规格创建 ECS 实例提供参考

DescribeInstanceTypes.description_en: Queries the information list of all instance types provided by Elastic Compute Service (ECS) and retrieves detailed information about instance types. You can also query specific instance types based on specific conditions to understand the configurations and performance of different instance types and select instances that meet your business requirements
DescribeInstanceTypes.description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询云服务器ECS提供的所有实例规格的信息列表并关联获取实例规格的详细信息，也可根据特定条件查询指定实例规格的信息，帮助您了解不同实例规格的配置和性能，以便选择适合自己业务需求的实例

DescribeInstanceVncUrl.description_en: Queries the VNC logon URL of an ECS instance
DescribeInstanceVncUrl.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台ECS实例的VNC登录地址

DescribeInstances.description_en: Queries the list of instances based on different request conditions and associates the conditional query with detailed information of the instances
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 本接口支持根据不同请求条件查询实例列表，并关联查询实例的详细信息

DescribeInstancesFullStatus.description_en: Queries the full status information of one or more ECS instances. The full status information includes the instance status and instance system event status. The instance status refers to the lifecycle status of the instance, and the instance system event refers to the health status of maintenance events
DescribeInstancesFullStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeInstancesFullStatus查询一台或多台ECS实例的全状态信息。全状态信息包括实例状态和实例系统事件状态，其中，实例状态为实例的生命周期状态，实例系统事件为维护事件的健康状态

DescribeInvocationResults.description_en: Queries the execution results of one or more Cloud Assistant commands, that is, the actual execution results on ECS instances
DescribeInvocationResults.description_zh: 调用DescribeInvocationResults查看一条或多条云助手命令的执行结果，即在ECS实例中的实际执行结果

DescribeInvocations.description_en: Queries the execution list and status of Cloud Assistant commands
DescribeInvocations.description_zh: 调用DescribeInvocations查询云助手命令的执行列表和状态

DescribeKeyPairs.description_en: Queries one or more SSH key pairs
DescribeKeyPairs.description_zh: 调用DescribeKeyPairs查询一个或多个密钥对

DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions.description_en: Queries information about launch template versions of ECS instances, such as the total number of instance launch templates, template names, and template version numbers
DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions.description_zh: 查询ECS实例启动模板版本的信息，例如实例启动模板总数、模板名称、模板版本号等

DescribeLaunchTemplates.description_en: Calls the DescribeLaunchTemplates operation to query information about one or more launch templates. You can specify parameters such as TemplateTag, TemplateResourceGroupId, and LaunchTemplateId. The returned information includes the total number of launch templates, template creation time, and latest template version number
DescribeLaunchTemplates.description_zh: 调用DescribeLaunchTemplates接口，并可以指定TemplateTag、TemplateResourceGroupId、LaunchTemplateId等参数，查询一个或多个实例启动模板的信息，例如启动模板总个数、模板创建时间、模板最新版本号等信息集合

DescribeLockedSnapshots.description_en: Queries the lock information of snapshots, such as the lock status and lock configurations
DescribeLockedSnapshots.description_zh: 查询快照的锁定信息。例如快照锁定状态、锁定配置等

DescribeManagedInstances.description_en: Queries the list of managed instances
DescribeManagedInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeManagedInstances查询托管实例列表

DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_en: Queries the details of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) by specifying the ENI ID
DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_zh: 指定弹性网卡ID，查询一个网卡的详细信息

DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions.description_en: Queries the list of Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions that you have granted to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user
DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions.description_zh: 调用DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions查询您授权给阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）或者个人用户的弹性网卡权限列表

DescribeNetworkInterfaces.description_en: Queries the details of one or more Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs)
DescribeNetworkInterfaces.description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性网卡（ENI）的详细信息

DescribeNewProjectEipMonitorData.description_en: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic IP Address (EIP) in the new BGP (Multi-ISP) network

DescribePortRangeListAssociations.description_en: Queries the resources associated with a specified port range list, such as security groups
DescribePortRangeListAssociations.description_zh: 查询指定端口列表已关联的资源信息，例如，安全组

DescribePortRangeListEntries.description_en: Queries the entries of a specified port range list
DescribePortRangeListEntries.description_zh: 查询指定端口列表的条目

DescribePortRangeLists.description_en: Queries a list of port range lists

DescribePrefixListAssociations.description_en: Queries the information about resources associated with a specified prefix list, such as resource IDs and resource types
DescribePrefixListAssociations.description_zh: 查询指定前缀列表已关联的资源信息，例如，资源ID和资源类型

DescribePrefixListAttributes.description_en: Queries the details of a specified prefix list, including the name, address family, maximum number of entries, and entry details
DescribePrefixListAttributes.description_zh: 查询指定前缀列表的详细信息，包含前缀列表的名称、地址族、最大条目容量以及条目的详细信息等

DescribePrefixLists.description_en: Queries the information about one or more prefix lists
DescribePrefixLists.description_zh: 调用DescribePrefixLists查询一个或多个前缀列表的信息

DescribePrice.description_en: Queries the latest prices of specified resources. You can query the latest prices of ECS instances, disks, dedicated hosts, elasticity assurance services, and capacity reservation services based on resource types. The prices include information such as campaign rules, prices, and discounts
DescribePrice.description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定资源的最新价格，支持根据资源类型查询ECS实例、云盘、专有宿主机、弹性保障服务、容量预定服务的最新价格，包括活动规则、价格、折扣等信息

DescribeRecommendInstanceType.description_en: (Beta) Queries one or more alternative instance types based on a specified instance type. For retired or soon-to-be-retired instance types, DescribeRecommendInstanceType lists all instance types that can serve as replacements
DescribeRecommendInstanceType.description_zh: （Beta）调用 DescribeRecommendInstanceType 根据一个指定的实例规格，查找一个或多个备选的实例规格。针对已经或者即将停售的实例规格，DescribeRecommendInstanceType会罗列出作为替补的所有实例规格

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries a list of regions based on parameters such as billing method and resource type
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 根据计费方式、资源类型等参数查询地域信息列表

DescribeRenewalPrice.description_en: Queries the renewal price of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) resources. Only subscription resources are supported
DescribeRenewalPrice.description_zh: 查询云服务器ECS资源的续费价格。仅支持查询包年包月资源的续费价格

DescribeReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribu.description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more reserved instances, including the auto-renewal duration and auto-renewal status
DescribeReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribu.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一个或多个预留实例券自动续费属性，包括自动续费时长和自动续费状态

DescribeReservedInstances.description_en: Queries the list of reserved instances that you have purchased in a specified region. You can filter reserved instances by tags, reserved instance attributes, and other parameters
DescribeReservedInstances.description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询指定地域下您已经购买的预留实例券信息列表，支持您根据标签、预留实例券属性等参数获取预留实例券详细信息列表

DescribeResourceByTags.description_en: Retrieves resources based on tags. You can retrieve resources by tag or by resource type
DescribeResourceByTags.description_zh: 调用DescribeResourceByTags根据标签检索资源。支持根据标签检索，也支持根据资源类型检索

DescribeResourcesModification.description_en: Queries the inventory of instance types or system disk types in a zone before you change the instance type or system disk type of an instance
DescribeResourcesModification.description_zh: 变更实例规格或系统盘类型之前，查询某一可用区下实例规格或系统盘的库存情况

DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.description_en: Queries the details of a specified security group, including the list of security group rules
DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询一个指定安全组的详细信息，并关联查询安全组规则详细信息列表

DescribeSecurityGroupReferences.description_en: Queries the list of other security groups that have been authorized by one or more specified security groups
DescribeSecurityGroupReferences.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一个或多个指定安全组已经被授权的其他安全组列表信息

DescribeSecurityGroups.description_en: Queries the basic information about security groups. You can filter results by region, security group ID, security group type, and other parameter query conditions
DescribeSecurityGroups.description_zh: 本接口用于查询安全组基本信息列表，支持您通过地域、安全组ID、安全组类型等不同参数查询

DescribeSendFileResults.description_en: Queries the list and status of files sent by Cloud Assistant
DescribeSendFileResults.description_zh: 调用DescribeSendFileResults查询云助手下发文件列表及状态

DescribeSnapshotGroups.description_en: Queries information about one or more snapshot-consistent groups, such as the status, instance ID, and snapshot creation progress
DescribeSnapshotGroups.description_zh: 查询一个或多个快照一致性组的信息。例如状态、所属的实例ID、快照创建进度等

DescribeSnapshotLinks.description_en: Queries snapshot chains of disks. A snapshot chain consists of all snapshots of a disk. Each disk corresponds to one snapshot chain
DescribeSnapshotLinks.description_zh: 查询云盘快照链。快照链是一块云盘所有快照组成的关系链，一块云盘对应一条快照链

DescribeSnapshotMonitorData.description_en: Queries the monitoring data of snapshot size changes within the last 30 days in a region
DescribeSnapshotMonitorData.description_zh: 查询一个地域下近30天内的快照容量变化监控数据

DescribeSnapshotPackage.description_en: Queries the Object Storage Service (OSS) storage plans that you have purchased in a region. Storage plans can be used to offset the storage capacity of standard snapshots but do not support offsetting local snapshots
DescribeSnapshotPackage.description_zh: 调用DescribeSnapshotPackage查询您在一个阿里云地域下已经购买的OSS存储包。存储包可以用于抵扣标准快照存储容量，但不支持抵扣本地快照

DescribeSnapshots.description_en: Queries the snapshot list of a disk, including snapshot status, remaining time for a snapshot being created, and automatic snapshot retention days
DescribeSnapshots.description_zh: 查询云盘的快照列表信息。例如快照状态、正在创建的快照剩余完成时间、自动快照保留天数等

DescribeSnapshotsUsage.description_en: Queries the number of snapshots and the total snapshot size in a region
DescribeSnapshotsUsage.description_zh: 查询您在一个地域下的快照数量以及快照容量

DescribeSpotAdvice.description_en: Queries the average release rate, average discount rate, and other information about spot instances in a specified region over the last 30 days
DescribeSpotAdvice.description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定地域下，抢占式实例近30天的平均释放率、平均折扣率等信息

DescribeSpotPriceHistory.description_en: Queries the historical prices of spot instances. You can query price data for up to the last 30 days. The historical price data helps you set a reasonable maximum price for a spot instance
DescribeSpotPriceHistory.description_zh: 本接口用于查询抢占式实例的历史价格，最多支持获取近30天内的数据，通过历史价格数据可以帮助您合理的设置抢占式实例的单台实例上限价格

DescribeStorageCapacityUnits.description_en: Queries the detailed information list of storage capacity units (SCUs). You can filter results by name, status, and capacity
DescribeStorageCapacityUnits.description_zh: 本接口用于查询存储容量单位包SCU（Storage Capacity Unit）的详细信息列表，支持根据名称、状态以及容量大小等条件进行查询

DescribeTags.description_en: Queries tags available to you. You can perform a conditional query for tags by resource type, resource ID, tag key, or tag value. The filter conditions are evaluated by using a logical AND (&&) operator, and only tags that match all filter conditions are returned
DescribeTags.description_zh: 查询可以供您使用的标签。您可以根据资源类型、资源ID、标签键或标签值等条件查询标签，筛选条件之间为逻辑与（&&）关系，返回满足所有筛选条件的标签

DescribeTaskAttribute.description_en: Queries the details of an asynchronous task. Currently, you can query the following asynchronous tasks: ImportImage, ExportImage, and ModifyDiskSpec
DescribeTaskAttribute.description_zh: 调用DescribeTaskAttribute查询异步任务的详细信息。目前，可以查询的异步任务有导入镜像（ImportImage）、导出镜像（ExportImage）及变更云盘类型（ModifyDiskSpec）

DescribeTasks.description_en: Queries the progress of one or more asynchronous requests
DescribeTasks.description_zh: 调用DescribeTasks查询一个或多个异步请求的进度

DescribeTerminalSessions.description_en: Queries the session history of Session Manager
DescribeTerminalSessions.description_zh: 查看Session Manager会话历史记录

DescribeUserBusinessBehavior.description_en: Retrieves the default attributes at the user level
DescribeUserBusinessBehavior.description_zh: 获取用户级别默认属性

DescribeUserData.description_en: Queries the user data of an ECS instance
DescribeUserData.description_zh: 本接口用于查询一台ECS实例的自定义数据

DescribeVscs.description_en: Queries virtual storage channels (VSCs). You can filter results by VscId, instance, status, or tags
DescribeVscs.description_zh: 查询虚拟存储通道，支持按照VscId、实例、状态、标签等条件过滤

DescribeZones.description_en: Queries the list of zones based on parameter query conditions such as region ID and billing method
DescribeZones.description_zh: 根据地域ID、计费方式等参数查询可用区信息列表

DetachClassicLinkVpc.description_en: Invokes DetachClassicLinkVpc to disconnect a classic network type ECS instance from a virtual private cloud (VPC) by removing the ClassicLink connection. After the ClassicLink connection is removed, the classic network type instance cannot communicate with instances in the VPC
DetachClassicLinkVpc.description_zh: 调用DetachClassicLinkVpc取消一台经典网络类型ECS实例与专有网络VPC的连接（ClassicLink）。取消ClassicLink后，经典网络类型实例无法与VPC内的实例互通

DetachDisk.description_en: Detaches a pay-as-you-go data disk or system disk from an ECS instance
DetachDisk.description_zh: 从一台ECS实例上卸载一块按量付费的数据盘或者系统盘

DetachInstanceRamRole.description_en: Detaches instance RAM roles from one or more ECS instances
DetachInstanceRamRole.description_zh: 本接口用于收回一台或多台ECS实例被授予的RAM角色

DetachKeyPair.description_en: Unbinds SSH key pairs from one or more Linux instances
DetachKeyPair.description_zh: 为一台或者多台Linux实例解绑SSH密钥对

DetachNetworkInterface.description_en: Detaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) from an ECS instance
DetachNetworkInterface.description_zh: 从一台ECS实例上分离一张弹性网卡（ENI）

DisableActivation.description_zh: 调用DisableActivation手动禁用指定的激活码

DisableDiskEncryptionByDefault.description_en: Disables account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region
DisableDiskEncryptionByDefault.description_zh: 关闭指定地域块存储账号级默认加密

DisableNetworkInterfaceQoS.description_en: Disables the QoS rate limiting settings for an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
DisableNetworkInterfaceQoS.description_zh: 禁用弹性网卡QoS限速设置

EnableDiskEncryptionByDefault.description_en: Enables account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region
EnableDiskEncryptionByDefault.description_zh: 开启指定地域块存储账号级默认加密

EnableNetworkInterfaceQoS.description_en: Enables or modifies the QoS rate limiting settings of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
EnableNetworkInterfaceQoS.description_zh: 启用或修改弹性网卡QoS限速设置

EndTerminalSession.description_en: Permanently closes the data connection of a specified session
EndTerminalSession.description_zh: 永久关闭指定Session的数据连接

ExportImage.description_en: Exports a custom image to an OSS bucket in the same region as the custom image
ExportImage.description_zh: 导出一份自定义镜像到与自定义镜像同一地域的OSS Bucket里

ExportSnapshot.description_en: Exports a snapshot to a specified object storage ddasd
ExportSnapshot.description_zh: 将快照导出到指定的对象存储ddasd

GetInstanceConsoleOutput.description_en: Retrieves the system command line output of an instance. The data is returned in Base64-encoded format
GetInstanceConsoleOutput.description_zh: 获取一台实例的系统命令行输出，数据以Base64编码后返回

GetInstanceScreenshot.description_en: Retrieves the screenshot information of an instance
GetInstanceScreenshot.description_zh: 调用GetInstanceScreenshot获取实例的截屏信息

ImportImage.description_en: Imports a local image file to Elastic Compute Service (ECS) as a custom image that appears in the specified region. You can then use the imported image to create ECS instances (RunInstances) or replace the system disk of an instance (ReplaceSystemDisk)
ImportImage.description_zh: 导入一份您的本地镜像文件到云服务器ECS，作为自定义镜像出现在相应地域中。后续您可以使用导入的镜像创建ECS实例（RunInstances），或者更换实例的系统盘（ReplaceSystemDisk）

ImportKeyPair.description_en: Imports the public key of an RSA key pair generated by another tool. After you import the key pair, Alibaba Cloud stores the public key. You must store the private key on your own
ImportKeyPair.description_zh: 导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分。导入密钥对后，阿里云为您保管公钥部分，您需要自行妥善保存密钥对的私钥部分

InstallCloudAssistant.description_en: Installs Cloud Assistant Agent on one or more ECS instances. You must restart the instances to complete the installation
InstallCloudAssistant.description_zh: 调用InstallCloudAssistant为一台或多台ECS实例安装云助手Agent。需要重启实例来完成安装云助手Agent的操作

InvokeCommand.description_en: Triggers a Cloud Assistant command on one or more ECS instances by specifying parameters such as CommandId, InstanceId, and ResourceGroupId
InvokeCommand.description_zh: 指定CommandId、InstanceId、ResourceGroupId等参数，为一台或多台ECS实例触发一条云助手命令

JoinResourceGroup.description_en: Adds an ECS resource or service to a resource group
JoinResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用JoinResourceGroup将一个ECS资源或者服务加入一个资源组

JoinSecurityGroup.description_en: Adds an ECS instance or an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a specified security group
JoinSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口用于将一台ECS实例或一张弹性网卡加入到指定的安全组

LeaveSecurityGroup.description_en: Removes an ECS instance or an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) from a specified security group
LeaveSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口用于将一台ECS实例或一张弹性网卡移出指定的安全组

ListPluginStatus.description_en: Queries the status of Cloud Assistant plugins on instances
ListPluginStatus.description_zh: 调用ListPluginStatus查询实例中云助手插件的状态

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are bound to one or more ECS resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个ECS资源已经绑定的标签列表

LockSnapshot.description_en: Locks a snapshot in compliance mode to prevent the snapshot from being accidentally or maliciously deleted. During the lock period, no user can delete the snapshot
LockSnapshot.description_zh: 以合规模式锁定快照，以防止快照被意外或者恶意删除。快照锁定期间，任何用户都无法将其删除

ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup.description_en: Modifies the configurations of an auto provisioning group
ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup.description_zh: 修改一个弹性供应组的配置信息

ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.description_en: Modifies an automatic snapshot policy, such as the snapshot creation time, repeat date, and retention period
ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.description_zh: 修改一条自动快照策略，例如，快照创建时间点、重复日期、保留时间等

ModifyBandwidthPackageSpec.description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of a bandwidth package

ModifyCapacityReservation.description_en: Modifies partial information of a capacity reservation, including the name, description, expiration method, and total number of reserved instances
ModifyCapacityReservation.description_zh: 调用ModifyCapacityReservation修改一个容量预定服务的部分信息，包括容量预定服务的名称、描述信息、失效方式以及预留的实例总数量

ModifyCloudAssistantSettings.description_en: Modifies the Cloud Assistant service configurations

ModifyCommand.description_en: Modifies the parameters of a Cloud Assistant command
ModifyCommand.description_zh: 调用ModifyCommand修改一条云助手命令相关参数

ModifyDedicatedHostAttribute.description_en: Modifies the information about a dedicated host, such as the name, description, and service availability attributes
ModifyDedicatedHostAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostAttribute修改一台专有宿主机的部分信息，包括专有宿主机的名称、描述和服务不可用属性等

ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime.description_en: Sets or cancels the automatic release time for a pay-as-you-go dedicated host
ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime.description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime为一台按量付费专有宿主机设定自动释放时间，或者取消自动释放一台按量付费专有宿主机

ModifyDedicatedHostAutoRenewAttribute.description_en: Configures auto-renewal for one or more subscription dedicated hosts, or cancels the auto-renewal that has been configured
ModifyDedicatedHostAutoRenewAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostAutoRenewAttribute为一台或多台包年包月专有宿主机设置自动续费，也可以取消已设定的自动续费

ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute.description_en: Modifies some information about a dedicated host cluster, including the name, description, and properties of the dedicated host cluster
ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute.description_zh: 修改一台专有宿主机组的部分信息，包括专有宿主机组的名称、描述信息、属性等

ModifyDedicatedHostsChargeType.description_en: Modifies the billing method of dedicated hosts
ModifyDedicatedHostsChargeType.description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostsChargeType修改专有宿主机的付费类型

ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a deployment set
ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute.description_zh: 修改一个部署集的名称和描述信息

ModifyDiagnosticMetricSet.description_en: Modifies a resource diagnostic metric set
ModifyDiagnosticMetricSet.description_zh: 修改资源诊断指标集合

ModifyDiskAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, release behavior, automatic snapshot deletion policy, automatic snapshot policy, performance burst settings, and other attributes of one or more block storage devices
ModifyDiskAttribute.description_zh: 修改一个或多个块存储设备的名称、描述、是否随实例释放、是否随磁盘删除其自动快照、是否启用自动快照策略、是否开启性能突发功能等

ModifyDiskChargeType.description_en: Converts the billing method of data disks attached to a subscription ECS instance between pay-as-you-go and subscription
ModifyDiskChargeType.description_zh: 将包年包月ECS实例上挂载的数据盘的计费方式在按量付费和包年包月之间进行转换

ModifyDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_en: Modifies the KMS key ID used for block storage account-level default encryption in a specified region
ModifyDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_zh: 修改指定地域块存储账号级默认加密使用的KMS密钥ID

ModifyDiskDeployment.description_en: Migrates a disk into or out of a dedicated block storage cluster, or between different dedicated block storage clusters
ModifyDiskDeployment.description_zh: 将云盘迁入、迁出专属块存储集群，或将云盘在不同专属块存储集群之间迁移

ModifyDiskSpec.description_en: Changes the type of a disk or modifies the performance level (PL) of an enterprise SSD (ESSD). Regional Enterprise SSD (ESSD) disks, basic disks, elastic ephemeral disks, and local disks do not support disk type changes
ModifyDiskSpec.description_zh: 变更一块云盘类型，或者修改一块ESSD云盘的性能级别。ESSD同城冗余云盘、普通云盘、弹性临时盘和本地盘均不支持变更云盘类型

ModifyElasticityAssurance.description_en: Modifies some information about an elasticity assurance, including its name, description, and capacity (only capacity reduction is supported)
ModifyElasticityAssurance.description_zh: 修改一个弹性保障服务的部分信息，包含名称、描述、容量（暂时只支持缩容）

ModifyElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttrib.description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurance services
ModifyElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttrib.description_zh: 修改一个或多个弹性保障服务的自动续费属性

ModifyForwardEntry.description_en: Modifies the properties of a specified forward entry

ModifyHaVipAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a specified HAVIP instance

ModifyHpcClusterAttribute.description_en: Modifies the description of an HPC cluster
ModifyHpcClusterAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyHpcClusterAttribute修改一个HPC集群的描述信息

ModifyImageAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a custom image, such as the image family, name, boot mode, status, and NVMe support, by calling the ModifyImageAttribute operation with parameters such as ImageId and ImageFamily
ModifyImageAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyImageAttribute接口，并可以指定ImageId、ImageFamily等参数，修改一份自定义镜像的属性，例如镜像族系、名称、启动模式、状态以及是否支持NVMe等

ModifyImageShareGroupPermission.description_en: Modifies the permissions of an image share group

ModifyImageSharePermission.description_en: Manages image sharing permissions. You can share your custom images with other Alibaba Cloud accounts or publish them as community images for others to use
ModifyImageSharePermission.description_zh: 管理镜像共享权限。您可以将自己的自定义镜像共享给其他阿里云账号，也可以发布为社区镜像供他人使用

ModifyInstanceAttachmentAttributes.description_en: Modifies the private pool matching mode of an instance
ModifyInstanceAttachmentAttributes.description_zh: 修改实例的私有池匹配模式

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an ECS instance, including the password, instance name, hostname, security groups, MTU, and instance user data
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台ECS实例的部分属性信息，支持修改密码、实例名称、主机名、所属安全组、实例的MTU以及用户自定义数据等

ModifyInstanceAutoReleaseTime.description_en: Modifies the automatic release time of a specified pay-as-you-go or spot instance. You can also use this operation to cancel the automatic release feature
ModifyInstanceAutoReleaseTime.description_zh: 本接口用于修改指定按量付费实例或者抢占式实例的自动释放时间，同时支持取消自动释放功能

ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription instances to help reduce the maintenance costs of expiring resources
ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台或多台包年包月实例的自动续费属性，可以帮助您减少资源到期的维护成本

ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_en: Modifies the billing method of ECS instances. Batch modification is supported
ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_zh: 本接口用于修改ECS实例的计费方式，支持批量修改

ModifyInstanceClockOptions.description_en: Modifies the clock options of an instance as needed
ModifyInstanceClockOptions.description_zh: 按需修改实例时钟选项

ModifyInstanceDeployment.description_en: Changes the deployment set of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance or migrates an ECS instance to a dedicated host. You can change the instance type of an ECS instance when you migrate the instance
ModifyInstanceDeployment.description_zh: 修改ECS实例的部署集，或迁移ECS实例至专有宿主机。支持在迁移ECS实例的同时变更实例规格

ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.description_en: Modifies the maintenance attributes of an instance

ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions.description_en: Modifies the metadata access settings for an instance in a specified region, including whether to enable the metadata access channel and whether to enable the security hardening mode for metadata access
ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions.description_zh: 本接口用于修改指定地域下实例内的元数据访问设置，包括是否启用元数据访问通道和访问元数据时是否启用强制加固模式等设置

ModifyInstanceNetworkOptions.description_en: Modifies the network options of an instance

ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec.description_en: Modifies the bandwidth configuration of an ECS instance, allocates a public IP address, converts the network billing method. Both upgrades and downgrades are supported
ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec.description_zh: 修改ECS实例的带宽配置、分配公网IP、转换网络计费方式，支持升配和降配

ModifyInstanceSecurityOptions.description_en: Modifies the secure boot options for an instance
ModifyInstanceSecurityOptions.description_zh: 修改实例启动的安全选项

ModifyInstanceSpec.description_en: Modifies the instance type or public bandwidth of a pay-as-you-go ECS instance
ModifyInstanceSpec.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台按量付费ECS实例的实例规格或者公网带宽大小

ModifyInstanceVncPasswd.description_en: Modifies the VNC logon password of an ECS instance
ModifyInstanceVncPasswd.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台ECS实例的VNC登录密码

ModifyInstanceVpcAttribute.description_en: Modifies the VPC, private IP address, security group, or vSwitch of a VPC-type ECS instance in a virtual private cloud (VPC) network type
ModifyInstanceVpcAttribute.description_zh: 修改一台专有网络类型ECS实例的专有网络VPC、私网IP地址、安全组或交换机

ModifyInvocationAttribute.description_en: Modifies the execution information of a Cloud Assistant scheduled task, including the command content, scheduled execution method, and adding ECS instances or managed instances to the task
ModifyInvocationAttribute.description_zh: 修改云助手定时任务的执行信息，包括命令内容、定时执行方式、添加ECS实例或托管实例到任务

ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion.description_en: Calls the ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion operation to switch the default version of a launch template by specifying the DefaultVersionNumber parameter. If you do not specify a template version number when you create an instance by calling the RunInstances operation, the default version is used
ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion.description_zh: 调用ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion接口，并通过指定DefaultVersionNumber参数，切换启动模板的默认版本。如果您在创建实例（RunInstances）时不指定模板版本号，则会采用默认版本

ModifyManagedInstance.description_en: Modifies the information of a managed instance
ModifyManagedInstance.description_zh: 调用ModifyManagedInstance修改一台托管实例的相关信息

ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI), such as the queue number, associated security groups, queue depth, communication mode, and whether to retain the ENI when the associated instance is released
ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_zh: 修改一个弹性网卡（ENI）的网卡队列数、所属安全组、队列深度、通讯模式以及释放实例时是否保留网卡等属性

ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a physical connection

ModifyPortRangeList.description_en: Modifies the name and entries of a specified port range list. You can add, modify, and delete entries
ModifyPortRangeList.description_zh: 修改指定端口列表的名称、条目，支持增加、修改和删除条目

ModifyPrefixList.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and other attributes of a specified prefix list, and supports adding, modifying, and deleting entries
ModifyPrefixList.description_zh: 修改指定前缀列表的名称、描述等，支持增加、修改和删除条目

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_en: Modifies the instance type of a subscription ECS instance. You can upgrade or downgrade the instance type. The new instance type takes effect for the entire lifecycle of the instance
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台包年包月ECS实例的实例规格，支持您升级或者降低实例规格，修改后的实例规格在实例整个生命周期内生效

ModifyReservedInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a reserved instance, including its name and description
ModifyReservedInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一张预留实例券的属性信息，包括名称和描述

ModifyReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more reserved instances, allowing you to cancel or disable auto-renewal
ModifyReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.description_zh: 本接口主要用于修改一个或多个预留实例券的自动续费属性，支持您取消或者关闭自动续费

ModifyReservedInstances.description_en: Splits, merges, or changes the scope of reserved instances by modifying configurations such as instance type, quantity, and zone
ModifyReservedInstances.description_zh: 本接口的主要功能是通过修改实例规格、数量、可用区等预留实例券的配置来对预留实例券进行拆分、合并或范围变更操作

ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a router interface

ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec.description_en: Modifies the specification of a router interface

ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name or description of a specified security group
ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一个指定安全组的名称或者描述信息

ModifySecurityGroupEgressRule.description_en: Modifies an outbound security group rule
ModifySecurityGroupEgressRule.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一条出方向安全组规则

ModifySecurityGroupPolicy.description_en: Modifies the intra-group connectivity policy of a basic security group
ModifySecurityGroupPolicy.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一个普通安全组的组内连通策略

ModifySecurityGroupRule.description_en: Modifies an inbound security group rule of a specified security group
ModifySecurityGroupRule.description_zh: 本接口用于修改指定安全组中的一条入方向安全组规则

ModifySnapshotAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, or retention period of a snapshot
ModifySnapshotAttribute.description_zh: 修改一份快照的名称、描述或保留天数

ModifySnapshotCategory.description_en: Modifies the type of a snapshot. You can call this operation to convert a standard snapshot to an archived snapshot
ModifySnapshotCategory.description_zh: 修改快照类型,可以通过该接口将标准快照转换为归档快照

ModifySnapshotGroup.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a snapshot-consistent group
ModifySnapshotGroup.description_zh: 修改快照一致性组的名称与描述信息

ModifyStorageCapacityUnitAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name or description of a storage capacity unit (SCU)
ModifyStorageCapacityUnitAttribute.description_zh: 本接口用于修改一个存储容量单位包SCU（Storage Capacity Unit）的名称或者描述信息

ModifySystemEventAttribute.description_en: Modifies the properties of a scheduled O&M event. Currently, you can modify the planned execute time of a scheduled O&M event
ModifySystemEventAttribute.description_zh: 修改计划内运维事件属性，目前支持修改计划内运维事件的计划执行时间

ModifyUserBusinessBehavior.description_zh: 设置用户级别默认属性

ModifyVpcAttribute.description_en: Modifies VPC attributes, such as its name and cidr block

PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.description_en: Purchases a reserved instance to offset bills of pay-as-you-go instances that match the specified instance type at the regional or zonal level
PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.description_zh: 本接口用于购买一张预留实例券，支持您购买一张地域级或者可用区级的预留实例券来抵扣对应规格的按量付费实例账单

PurchaseStorageCapacityUnit.description_en: Purchases one or more storage capacity units (SCUs)
PurchaseStorageCapacityUnit.description_zh: 本接口用于购买一个或多个存储容量单位包SCU（Storage Capacity Unit）

ReActivateInstances.description_en: Restarts a pay-as-you-go ECS instance that has expired or been recycled due to an overdue payment
ReActivateInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于重新启动一台已过期或欠费回收的按量付费ECS实例

ReInitDisk.description_en: Re-initializes a disk to its initial state when it was created
ReInitDisk.description_zh: 重新初始化一块磁盘至创建时的初始状态

RebootInstance.description_zh: 本接口用于重启一台ECS实例

RebootInstances.description_en: Restarts one or more ECS instances. You can specify whether to force restart instances and set different batch operation modes
RebootInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于重启一台或多台ECS实例，支持您通过参数来选择是否强制重启和设置不同的批量操作模式

RedeployDedicatedHost.description_en: Performs fault migration for a dedicated host
RedeployDedicatedHost.description_zh: 执行专有宿主机的故障迁移

RedeployInstance.description_en: Invokes the RedeployInstance operation to redeploy an ECS instance when the ECS instance receives a system event notification
RedeployInstance.description_zh: 当ECS实例收到系统事件通知时，调用RedeployInstance可以重新部署这台ECS实例

ReleaseCapacityReservation.description_zh: 调用ReleaseCapacityReservation释放容量预定服务

ReleaseDedicatedHost.description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go dedicated host or an expired subscription dedicated host
ReleaseDedicatedHost.description_zh: 本接口用于释放一台按量付费专有宿主机或者到期的包年包月专有宿主机

ReleaseEipAddress.description_en: Releases a specified Elastic IP Address (EIP)

ReleasePublicIpAddress.description_en: Releases a public IP from an instance

RemoveTags.description_en: Unbinds one or more tags from resources such as instances, cloud disks, snapshots, images, or security groups
RemoveTags.description_zh: 调用RemoveTags从实例、磁盘、快照、镜像或者安全组等解绑一个或多个标签

RenewDedicatedHosts.description_en: Renews one or more subscription dedicated hosts
RenewDedicatedHosts.description_zh: 续费一台或者多台包年包月的专有宿主机

RenewElasticityAssurances.description_en: Renews one or more purchased elasticity assurance services
RenewElasticityAssurances.description_zh: 对一个或多个已购买的弹性保障服务进行续费

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a subscription Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. You can specify the renewal period or renew the instance to a unified expiration date
RenewInstance.description_zh: 本接口用于续费一台包年包月的 ECS 实例，支持您设置续费时长或者续费至统一到期日

RenewReservedInstances.description_en: Renews one or more reserved instances. You can specify the purchase duration and auto-renewal attribute during renewal
RenewReservedInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于对一张或多张预留实例券进行续费，支持您在续费时设置购买时长和自动续费属性

ReplaceSystemDisk.description_en: Replaces the operating system of an ECS instance by replacing the system disk. After the replacement, the disk ID of the system disk changes and the original disk is released
ReplaceSystemDisk.description_zh: 通过更换ECS实例系统盘的方式更换操作系统。更换后系统盘的云盘ID将发生变化，原云盘会被释放

ReportInstancesStatus.description_en: Reports anomalous issues for one or more ECS instances. You can report the same issue that occurs on multiple ECS instances or the same issue that occurs on multiple disks attached to a single ECS instance
ReportInstancesStatus.description_zh: 调用ReportInstancesStatus反馈一台或者多台ECS实例的异常问题。您可以反馈多台ECS实例发生的相同问题，也可以反馈一台ECS实例的多块磁盘发生的相同问题

ResetDisk.description_en: Rolls back a cloud disk to a previous state by using a cloud disk snapshot
ResetDisk.description_zh: 使用云盘快照，将云盘回滚到之前某一特定的历史状态

ResetDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_en: Resets the KMS key ID used for account-level default encryption of block storage in a specified region to the service key
ResetDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.description_zh: 将指定地域块存储账号级默认加密使用的 KMS 密钥 ID 重置为服务密钥的接口

ResetDisks.description_en: Rolls back one or more cloud disks by using an instance snapshot
ResetDisks.description_zh: 通过实例快照回滚一个或多个云盘

ResizeDisk.description_en: Expands the capacity of a disk, including system disks and data disks
ResizeDisk.description_zh: 扩容一块磁盘，支持扩容系统盘和数据盘

RevokeSecurityGroup.description_en: Deletes one or more inbound security group rules from a specified security group
RevokeSecurityGroup.description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定安全组内的一条或多条入方向安全组规则

RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.description_en: Deletes one or more outbound security group rules from a specified security group
RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定安全组内的一条或多条出方向安全组规则

RunCommand.description_en: Creates and runs a Cloud Assistant command on one or more ECS instances. Supports Shell, PowerShell, or Bat script types, and provides features such as scheduled execution, custom parameters, and execution within containers on instances
RunCommand.description_zh: 本接口用于在一台或多台ECS实例中创建并执行云助手命令，支持Shell、PowerShell或者Bat类型的脚本，支持定时执行、自定义参数和实例内容器执行等功能

RunInstances.description_en: Batch creates ECS instances with support for automatic startup, public IP address allocation, and automatic release time settings
RunInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于批量创建ECS实例，支持自动启动、分配公网IP及设置自动释放时间

SendDiagnosticInterrupt.description_en: Sends a diagnostic interrupt to a specified ECS instance to trigger an operating system crash and generate a memory dump file
SendDiagnosticInterrupt.description_zh: 向指定ECS实例发送诊断中断，触发操作系统崩溃并生成内存转储文件

SendFile.description_en: Sends a remote file to one or more ECS instances
SendFile.description_zh: 调用SendFile向一台或多台ECS实例下发远程文件

StartImagePipelineExecution.description_en: Executes an image building task by using an image template
StartImagePipelineExecution.description_zh: 通过一个镜像模板执行构建镜像的任务

StartInstance.description_en: Starts an ECS instance. You can start an instance by specifying the instance ID and optionally setting parameters such as InitLocalDisk
StartInstance.description_zh: 本接口用于启动一台ECS实例，您可以通过指定实例ID以及按需设置 InitLocalDisk 等参数启动实例

StartInstances.description_en: Starts multiple ECS instances in a batch. You can specify parameters to select different batch operation modes for flexible startup
StartInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于批量启动 ECS 实例，支持通过设置参数来选择不同的批量操作模式，为您提供灵活的启动方式

StartTerminalSession.description_en: Invokes StartTerminalSession to create a session based on the session management feature. You can establish a WebSocket session with an ECS instance by specifying the instance ID. The WebSocketUrl returned by the operation can be used to establish a remote connection to the ECS instance
StartTerminalSession.description_zh: 调用StartTerminalSession基于会话管理功能创建一个会话。您可以通过指定ECS实例ID与该实例建立一个WebSocket会话，通过接口返回的WebSocketUrl可以远程连接到ECS实例

StopInstance.description_en: Stops an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. You can specify the stop method, stop mode, and batch operation mode
StopInstance.description_zh: 本接口用于停止一台ECS实例，支持选择不同的停机方式、停机模式以及批量操作模式停止实例

StopInstances.description_en: Stops one or more ECS instances. You can specify different stop methods, stop modes, and batch operation modes
StopInstances.description_zh: 本接口用于停止一台或多台 ECS 实例，支持选择不同的停机方式、停机模式以及批量操作模式停止实例

StopInvocation.description_en: Stops a running Cloud Assistant command process on one or more ECS instances
StopInvocation.description_zh: 调用StopInvocation停止一台或多台ECS实例中一条正在进行中（Running）的云助手命令进程

TagResources.description_en: Creates and binds tags to specified ECS resources in a single operation
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的ECS资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UnassignIpv6Addresses.description_en: Unassigns one or more IPv6 addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
UnassignIpv6Addresses.description_zh: 回收一个或多个弹性网卡IPv6地址

UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.description_en: Removes one or more secondary private IP addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.description_zh: 从一张弹性网卡删除一个或多个辅助私有IP地址

UnassociateHaVip.description_en: Disassociates an HaVip from an ECS instance

UnlockSnapshot.description_en: Unlocks a snapshot that is locked in compliance mode but is still within the cooling-off period. If the snapshot is locked in compliance mode and the cooling-off period has ended, the snapshot cannot be unlocked
UnlockSnapshot.description_zh: 解锁以合规模式锁定但仍处于冷静期内的快照。若快照以合规模式锁定且冷静期已结束，则无法解锁

UntagResources.description_en: Unbinds tags from specified ECS resources. After a tag is unbound, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources为指定的ECS资源列表统一解绑标签。解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，会被自动删除
